summary: Slice S04a covers LE/20__System__Viewports, LE/21__System__SitePlanData, LE/25__System__RenderStyles and Panel__SitePlanComposites: 32 TV files (12,327 lines) against 21 VV files (6,609). 21 pairs are shared (15 drifted, 6 marked header-only, but 4 of those 6 really carry changes) and 11 files exist only in TV. Folder names and numbers already match, so nothing needs renaming. The only folder gap is LE/21, which TV moved there from top-level 52 in v2.155.0. VV last took changes for this slice on 13-20 Sep. Since then TV has added: Enhance strength (v2.93), depth fog per drawing (v2.94), base-image styling of nested detail tags (unlogged commit 6076ec10), one storey per plan for doors (v2.105), Draft guards (v2.107), the Vector quality control (v2.136), rotatable viewports (v2.138, wired through 31 TV files), Hide swings (v2.140), a per-viewport Line scale and Fill override (unlogged commit 55014c6a) and the site legend (v2.164). Older TV-first features were never ported: Model Source (v2.32), plan doors (v2.42/v2.48.1) and the whole site plan system (v2.48-v2.164, touching 27 TV LE files). SnapshotRenderer must be ported hunk by hunk to keep VV's DIV-1 composer seams. Most other drifted files can be taken whole from TV, with VV's header and folder numbers put back, once small enabling leaves exist (ViewportRotation, DraftMode__State). One trap: Render2d, Render3d and EnsureLinework take positional arguments in a different order in the two apps, so a ported TV caller would silently pass the wrong values. Recommended decisions: port site plans and Model Source dormant (UI unchanged, code verbatim); keep Vale's own R2 prefix and stems for site plan data; add a callback route to VV's tiled renderer for fog images. Also flagged: back-ports to TV (entourage silhouettes, Add Viewport refresh, SectionAdapter SetModelRoot) and stale headers and ledger rows on both sides.

findings.title: Render entry points take different positional arguments in the two apps
findings.detail: TV Render2d(def,win,styles,w,h,layers,samples,weights,modelSourceId,stillWanted,depthFog) vs VV (..,weights,stillWanted). findings.title: SnapshotRenderer's DIV-1 seams must survive every port
findings.detail: VV renders drawings through its composer (DIV-1). VV uses ComposerPreset__Enter({edgeWidthPx}) (:502) where TV uses RenderPreset + SetEdgeWidth. It sets edges through Na__LineworkSettings__SetLineworkBaseOverride (:504,:581) rather than writing material linewidths, and Na__CrossSection__SetLineWidth rather than SectCutCfg. It renders with Na__LeSnap__Camera (:511), not the ortho. It hides with SetCategoryVisibility(key,false,true) (:451), exact-key and silent. Its CONTEXT_CATEGORIES include ValeVision__SceneEntourageSilhouette (:418, VV 1.3.1).
findings.recommendation: Record these six seams in VV SnapshotRenderer's PORT NOTE and in the ledger. A port that removes any of them is a regression. Every new TV width or pass must go in through the VV system that owns it.
findings.evidence: VV SnapshotRenderer :418,:451-452,:502,:504,:511,:523; VV ledger :745-:755 ('The consumers are the divergence, and it is deliberate').
